name: Shared task list
description: A realtime multiplayer task list with assignees. A good starting point for trackers and checklists.
headline: What needs *doing*?
intro: Your task list is open on the right. The agent can add, assign, reorder and check off tasks for you — everyone with access sees changes live.

suggestions.p: Fill this list with the tasks for planning a two-day team offsite.
Help me break a goal into concrete tasks for this list. Ask me what the goal is first.
Tidy this list: merge duplicates, make each task an actionable verb phrase, and order by priority.
Summarize the completed tasks in one paragraph, then clear them from the list.
Add due dates to this task list app: a date picker per task, overdue tasks in red, sorted by date.
